title: Janus v2.2.3 — Real-Time Call Logs, SMS, and Screen Mirror Live Stream
notes: Fix Screen Mirroring: Removed BlackoutActivity so real live phone screen streams to Mac instead of black box
Fix Call History & SMS Fetching: Resolved SQLite query crash caused by strict SQL validator rejecting LIMIT token
Real-Time Sync: Added ContentObservers for calls and SMS with debounced real-time push to Mac
Auto-Sync on Connect & Call End: Instantly pushes call logs and SMS on connection and call termination
UI Polish: Prevented stale media timeout notifications from leaking into other tabs
